roi_policy: Union of Prior and MVS backprojected source XY within frozen regional domains; no reference Z or outcome labels
camera_selection: Exact three reference cameras per region from sealed parent evidence; no accepted-point seed or mask reuse
vote_policy: At least two supporting neighbors and strictly more support than opposition; symmetric Prior/MVS; ties abstain
profile_policy: All eligible selected neighbors including opposing and neutral margins; complete 7x7 support across both source-normal branches and all 33 depth hypotheses
parallax_policy: Both source hypotheses must have same-neighbor parallax at least 1 degree
mask_policy: Only the independently tested center pixel receives a decision; no patch label spread, interpolation, dilation, hole fill, or SAM/DINO
limitations: Observed source disagreement does not identify temporal change versus prior error or registration error.
Compatibility is conditioned on the named depth model, not independently verified physical visibility.
Current imagery and MVS share lineage; source support is not independent accuracy validation.
7x7 patches measure each center; strict complete profile support can leave true boundaries undecided.
Only pixels in frozen regional source-XY support receive expensive evidence checks; outside coverage stays explicit.
No GaussianUpdate or CL-Splats reproduction, precision/recall claim, Gaussian connection, or Gaussian update is performed.
